description: seven: the steward, the woman who owes (whose mother the Rose holds), two estate men, the crossing-keeper and two witnesses from the road
BM&V's 'House' named the Chainbreakers' house; a carved post with broken chains by its front door (exterior door 15647F, at 32,-14), from BM&V's own Argonian statics

the estate's landing on the road north of the town, a work shed, a dredging boat, the woman's boat, the steward's account book (a short readable book, several pages), and the crossing-keeper's toll post apart from it, from BM&V's own Argonian statics
one freed debtor on Lilmoth's shore who speaks of the Chainbreakers' house at Blackrose, the line's first word
two Chainbreakers who shelter there, freed debtors, who keep the house while Never-Sold goes with the player
Never-Sold, a woman born owing who discharged it, a careful accountant who remembers every bought-out name

cells, smoke and fire states under enable parents (smoke, burning, burnt), from BM&V's own pieces; a sealed door below that the fire does not open (the old dead beyond it, prisons Q3); the heirs' book that holds the estate woman's mother stays unburnt and may be carried out
a stockade gate of stakes around the new door at the 'Black Rose Jail' marker, from BM&V's own pieces
navmesh for the Rose's lower levels so the heirs and the held can walk
the cell's name 'Quick Test Cell' becomes the Rose's lower levels
two heirs who go in with the player, three of the heirs' held, and two gate-keepers at the post (095447)
a moored barge with a cabin and a deck, from BM&V's own boat statics, and a shelf of bound ledgers in the cabin
Ussa-Rekh and three of a freed crew

description: a door pair: a new door at BMN's 'Black Rose Jail' marker outside Blackrose into 01BlackRoseJail, the Rose's lower levels; the interior's exit 1F5AE4 re-pointed to it; the old exterior door 1EEB70 in BlackMarsh2 (-8,26) disabled
one river-beast under the pier, fixed band, under an enable parent that LQ25's first stage turns on
four raft-polers in two crews
the gate of stakes at the city's edge, a trail of cut reeds and a reed shelter, from BM&V's own statics
one young Argonian in a shelter in the basin, the youth's kin by the gate, and the tree-minder of the youth's clutch (not MQ05's)
three on the barge: the broker's overseer who reads the roll and two hired port hands; and the An-Xileel courier with the satchel
the debt-labour broker who hires the gang to Hereguard, on the pier at Dock1

the camp on the shore at -1,0 (an islet if the water there allows, measured at build; else a shore camp with the escape along the bank), from BM&V's own Argonian swamp statics (huts, hatching shed with its clutch, the Hist cutting from BM&V's Hist static scaled down, uxith, grave-stakes, rowboat); enable parents for orderly, attacked and aftermath (the cutting withdrawn, the uxith dark)
three of the Unbound Root cell and Cuts-the-Old-Knot, who is scene-protected and leaves before the player is free
the pier door from the hold (005AB4, a Castle Volkihar model) and the ship's Lilmoth door (0AA664, a Solitude jail model) take BM&V's own Argonian door base (0006)
four of the gang families who live at the camp and keep its cutting and clutch, an egg-tender among them

six of the Owing gang, in the hold at processing and marched to the camp, two washed out from years away from their Hist; three are the witnesses, one of whom is saved; never more than three active in a pocket
the hold cell's location is cleared of vanilla Skyrim's 'Dainty Sload' (07B91A:Skyrim.esm), so no Skyrim name shows in the hold
Valenwood.esp's start-game quests 0MainQuest1 and AANEWQuestM (0F0F3E) do not start until the player first enters Valenwood, so nothing of theirs reaches a Black Marsh opening
BM&V's greeting quest 01Captain ('Welcome to Black Marsh') does not start until MQ03 ends
navmesh on the pier square 1,-3 where the hold's door opens, joined to 1,-2
a persistent start marker in the hold; ARG_Opening points at it instead of the pier marker; the overseer's march package takes the gang and the courier from the plank to the camp

the house's outer door 0FE95A (RiftenDoorLoad01, a Riften model) and its inner door 0FE832 in cell 0FE7F7 (WRShackDoor01, a Whiterun model) take the base of BM&V's own Lilmoth house doors (0006); after the bargain the outer door is set open to the player (setDoorAccess), the safehouse of the Reed's tier-1 reward

a lighting template for the fog and a circle of root shapes in the hold under an enable parent the dream turns on, the hold's door (005AB4) locked under the same parent; the barge has sailed, so the crew and the gang stand under MQ01's own parent, which MQ01's end turns off, and the hold is empty
Nesh-Deeka and the fish-trader who keeps the house

the player's fellow hurt: the saved witness (Sal-Sei, Deesh-Duun or Ties-The-Loose-Plank, else Dives-Without-A-Rope) and Finds-The-Other-Bank, existing registry people, moved by MoveTo at the fade to the two mats in the back room under one enable parent that every ending turns off

in the camp's aftermath the sap spilled on the shed floor where the cell's jars stood, with ring-marks in it, and an activator that gives a phial of it (a miscellaneous item on BM&V's own small bottle); a drop on the tongue is what brings the dream

two of the Reed's people with a boat, one of them Never-Writes-Twice (an existing registry person, seen and not named), who take only the hurt, the player among them, off at dawn (the overseer takes the barge at once with the unhurt and the families); the move to the house is a fade and a MoveTo
the freed survivor of e-theirs standing under an enable parent on the shore road out of Lilmoth, in the exterior cell (not the house's interior)

the house as a front room and a back room (cell 0FE7F7 measured at build; if it is one room a screen divides it): in the front room a table and a marker where the broker is moved to sit for the bargain (mark.mq03.broker-seat) and the fish-trader at the outer door; in the back room the screen, Nesh-Deeka, two sleeping mats for the hurt and a scrape of the camp's spilled sap on a table for a player who took none; BM&V's own Argonian clutter; and a marker on the Lilmoth dock (mark.mq03.dock) where the broker is put back after the bargain

the cell's camp on a dry rise in the north reeds an hour on foot through the shallows from the workshop (ref.mq04.cell-camp, on from stage 10, from BM&V's own Argonian statics) with the two cell men, Hides-His-Wake and Counts-The-Jars (npc rows cell-man-1 and cell-man-2, each wearing the knotted cord at the wrist, an actor package of a fire and a sleep at night; cell-man-1 keeps the camp's edge on the trail side as a sentry by night, with detection, and the fire's smoke shows over the rise at dusk, visible from the herald's platform and the stair), the faint gum drips that are lost at the leech water and show again on its far side where the reed stems are bent, (drips always present, no tide or dusk gate, tideState being flavour only); in every ending the camp is disabled (the men gone by their larger boat once the jars are poured) and ref.mq04.bound-at-fence is disabled, an unshown captive being led off by the kaal's spears; a subdued cell man is a state swap: he is disabled at the camp and a bound man (same npc, ref.mq04.bound-at-fence, no escort walk) enabled at the fence, npcInCustody is true while the bound man's ref is enabled at the fence (the planner's), and later ref.mq04.bound-at-weirs at the weirs and the tending-ground under the kaal's spears for the counted award of nushmeekos the root-herald sets him (QA17), the ref disabled when it is worked; the cell's pole-boat lies at the camp; the departing boat of the handing is a disable (ref.mq04.guarded)

the items: BM&V's own leech as an ingredient (thing.mq04.leech, placed by we.mq04.leeches), BM&V's own clay jars full of sap by the camp's fire (thing.mq04.sap-jars, a miscellaneous item the player may take, a quest item that cannot be sold or dropped), and the tree-minder's knife, BM&V's own Argonian knife, by the camp's fire, kept for the next draw (thing.mq04.knife)
the Argonian Chief's placed ref is named Kaal, the village's war-captain, so that the display name does not read as its ruler while the root-herald judges

leech actors (BM&V's Leech and Giant Leech, a few) in the water at the cut root (zone.mq04.root) and the lowest pool, and one gatherable leech ingredient there (thing.mq04.leech); none in the upper pools, and none on any path of the village
the Village named from the lore's Murkmire villages

five in the village: the tree-minder Pays-Late, the egg-tender Turns-The-Clutch, the root-herald Hires-By-The-Season (placed on the platform at the Hist's foot, near the fence; her registry row is a generated npc with no placement yet), Zaren-Ish, the Veiled Reed's unmarked hand (home place Lilmoth), in a boat off the village, and the Lilmoth go-between Carries-Both-Ways on the jetty from stage 10 (only Zaren-Ish's boat is under ref.mq04.guarded); starting regard (npc base_disposition) is below every speech gate: the root-herald 18, the egg-tender 20, the tree-minder 10, so the gates of 30, 30 and 20 need a persuade and the surety's 40 can fail; the tree-minder's package takes him to mark.mq04.cut-root to wash the cut after dark and to the pool by day; after the adoption the root-herald gives a bed and food (service.low-reed-village.lodging) and the tree-minder's sap-balm heals (service.low-reed-village.healing); no kin price (the village trades in reciprocity); the Argonian Chief stays the kaal; the cell men are we.mq04.cell

the village's Hist (BM&V's Hist static, if the cell has none already) with withdrawn and healthy enable parents, the closed tending-ground with its fence (zone.mq04.fence), the first stair (zone.mq04.stair) and the cut root (zone.mq04.root, mark.mq04.cut-root), a dark uxith, the jetty (zone.mq04.jetty), a sap-workshop with a fresh-cut bar on its door (pale wood, fitted the morning after the theft) from BM&V's own Argonian statics, and the tending-ground's terraced pools built explicitly (the lowest pool by the cut root, the upper pools above it); enable parents ref.mq04.withdrawn, ref.mq04.reconciled (the Hist's leaves part and its light comes back low), ref.mq04.guarded (Zaren-Ish's boat off the village, on from stage 10), ref.mq04.second-dull (a second pool above the lowest dull, on from stage 30, off in every ending) and ref.mq04.hearing (the village gathered at the fence with the Argonian Chief, the kaal, standing by, on at stage 60, off in every ending); dressing: the cut root (cut at the ring, sealed with black gum, dry at the cut) at zone.mq04.root and the rings of jars pressed in the gum on the sap-workshop floor; the planner takes the surety Owing's weirs work and the 2.10 terms (inZone, timeOfDay, present-evidence)

the weirs' work spot (ref.mq04.weirs-work, enabled by e-sheltered): an activator at the fish weirs where the player works off the season of nushmeekos stood for Pays-Late by day, the netters greeting them there; working it off settles the surety (a quest flag, not the Owing ledger)
a travelling Nisswo and Helstrom's tree-minder of the grove by the hall, named apart from MQ04's
two Reed escorts on the landing where the ship sets down, under an enable parent MQ05's end turns off; the player boards at Lilmoth's ship door (0AA837, 7,-1)
a small grove of root and a young Hist (BM&V's Hist static, scaled) by the hall, where the dispute is held
the hall cell named the Hall of the Scalded Throne
BM&V's Argonian soldier in the hall becomes the hall's sweeper (no uniform; a broom)
a plain root-and-reed seat at the hall's end, swept, with a sweeper's broom; no dais
'Docks' named Soulrest: a port on the 01Ship coast line
three of the Chapter in the cleared dungeon, among them Vasha Half-Rent
three: the thief, the keepsake's owner and the thief's drinking friend
two of the three door pairs into Soulrest's one room are locked with no key, both sides (outer 11ACD3 and 120E95, inner 11ACA1 and 11ABF3), so the back room has one way in, by 120E93 and 0E971F
Deep-In-Her-Cups, the Chapter's teetotal desk at Soulrest, in the back room
BM&V's cell 'Pussbottom' named Pusbottom
the thief's bedroll under a boardwalk awning and a drinking spot by the water, from BM&V's own statics
a Khajiit trader on the dock who sells to the Chapter and sends people to Deep-In-Her-Cups's door
three clients on the canal front
a sunk stilt house on the canal floor and the lockbox with a carved token, a charm and a deed-stake, from BM&V's own house statics
